title: sparse_FIR~
description: `sparse_FIR~` convolves an input signal with a sparse FIR coefficient list containing alternating index/value pairs for nonzero coefficients; an equivalent matrix message can also define the coefficients. Its creation argument sets the maximum convolution length, which can later be changed with a `size` or `order` message, while unspecified coefficient positions are reset to zero and not calculated.
